claims.allowed_text: In the audited WebArena execution protocol, task-order permutation changes persistent website state as well as the sequence seen by the self-improving memory system.
claims.not_allowed: Every task permutation necessarily changes benchmark state or invalidates its evaluator.

claims.allowed_text: The released AWM shuffle trajectory contains a direct write-to-reader chain in which a prior task successfully mutates the shopping backend despite a FAIL benchmark verdict, and a later task correctly reads the new current state but is scored against stale fixed ground truth.
claims.not_allowed: All scorer failures in the release are caused by stale ground truth.

claims.allowed_text: For three predefined dynamic-reference tasks, AWM and ReasoningBank pass all 18 ordinal method-run evaluations and fail all 36 corresponding shuffled evaluations across two shuffle seeds.
claims.not_allowed: The 100-point sentinel risk difference applies to all WebArena tasks.

claims.allowed_text: The released-trajectory retrospective identifies 887 lower-bound state-exposed sensitive-reader units in memory-method shuffles, of which 424 fail. Excluding preregistered state-sensitive readers reduces AWM's observed shuffle gap by 34.6-44.5% and ReasoningBank's by 14.9-17.5%. The remaining gap is residual order sensitivity after the environment-sensitive stratum is removed.
claims.not_allowed: Those percentages are the causal fraction of the original paper's degradation explained by environment contamination.

claims.allowed_text: Environment carryover does not explain the full task-order effect: a sizeable residual remains after state-sensitive-reader exclusion.
claims.not_allowed: The original self-improvement fragility result is an artifact.

claims.allowed_text: A state-isolated order-stress protocol with a matched shuffled no-memory control separates memory-history sensitivity from environment-history sensitivity under the same execution stack.
claims.not_allowed: A no-memory shuffled agent has already been observed to show the same degradation.
